title: The Limit Sets of Linear and Nonlinear Infinite IFSs Related to Complex Continued Fractions
summary: We introduce two families of infinite iterated function systems (IFSs) $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{d}, T)$ and $\mathcal{G}(\mathbf{d}, T)$, parametrized by a sequence of positive real numbers $\mathbf{d}$ and a natural number $T$, and investigate the measure-theoretic properties of their limit sets. $\mathcal{G}(\mathbf{d}, T)$ is an infinite Möbius IFS, which is an extension of the IFS of real continued fractions to the IFS on the closed unit disc in the complex plane. $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{d}, T)$ is an infinite linear IFS that shares the same first approximation as $\mathcal{G}(\mathbf{d}, T)$.…
